caption: The drawing depicts a brass or brass-colored flask with a teardrop shape and a cylindrical neck at the top. The flask has four metal rings attached to its sides, two on each side near the top and bottom sections. The surface of the flask features embossed decorations, including an American eagle with wings outstretched and a shield on its chest, perched above a cannon. Below the eagle and cannon are two crossed flags, resembling the American flag with visible stars and stripes, draped outward on either side. Additional military motifs such as cannonballs and what appears to be a sword and horn are incorporated near the bottom. Above the eagle are crossed pistols and a circular arrangement of stars. The background of the image is plain and off-white, emphasizing the detailed texture and golden-brown shades of the flask. The artist's signature, "W.K. Miller," appears in red near the bottom right corner.
title: Powder Flask
